# Links from Markdown

Cross-format links connect Markdown sources and reStructuredText sources in one
documentation site. Sphinx resolves their source paths to the appropriate HTML
and generated Markdown destinations.

## Related examples

1. Read the [MyST Markdown example](myst.md) for metadata and fenced directives.
2. Visit the [RST apple example](apples.rst) for a reStructuredText source page.
